# Python reporting contracts

<!-- Generated by vgi.codegen.reporting_docs; edit vgi/reporting/*.py. -->

The importable definitions live in `vgi/reporting/`. Each protocol has its own source module and generated reference page. Service implementations and the SQL adapter remain separate work.

Methods take direct named arguments, with dataclasses for structured values such as report envelopes, schedules and notifications. Scalar arguments are individual RPC columns; dataclass arguments and unary dataclass results use the framework's binary IPC encoding. Producer row schemas and safe SQL reads are explicit annotations.
